title: Safety observation
description: A hazard, near miss or unsafe condition noticed at work.
requirement: Record a safety observation from a workplace: when and where it was noticed, what was observed, what kind of hazard it is, how serious it could have been, what was done right away and what should be done next.

fields.name: observation_date
fields.label: Date
fields.description: The day the observation was made.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: Where the hazard was noticed: site, building, floor or area.

fields.name: description
fields.label: What was observed
fields.description: What was seen or what happened, in one or two sentences.

fields.name: hazard_type
fields.label: Hazard type
fields.description: The kind of hazard the observation is about.

fields.name: severity
fields.label: Severity
fields.description: How serious the outcome was or could have been.

fields.name: immediate_action
fields.label: Immediate action
fields.description: What was done on the spot to remove or mark the hazard.

fields.name: follow_up
fields.label: Proposed follow-up
fields.description: What should still be done so that the hazard does not come back.
